hooks.name: load-agents-and-workflow-context
hooks.description: Loads and injects AGENTS.md and development-process.md as startup context for the session

hooks.name: sequential-gate-check-before-subagent
hooks.description: Enforces sequential pipeline progression before executing sub-agents

hooks.name: sequential-gate-check-before-ask-user
hooks.description: Enforces sequential pipeline progression before asking for developer commit approval

hooks.name: enforce-planning-before-exit-plan-mode
hooks.description: Enforces that a valid plan-approval.json signature exists before exiting plan mode

hooks.name: block-rancher-git
hooks.description: Prevents running git remote operations against rancher-owned remotes

hooks.name: enforce-planning-before-write
hooks.description: Enforces that a plan/checklist must be created or modified before writing files

hooks.name: enforce-planning-before-replace
hooks.description: Enforces that a plan/checklist must be created or modified before replacing text in files

hooks.name: generate-approvals-after-ask
hooks.description: Automatically and securely generates plan or commit approvals after developer clicks/types approval

hooks.name: generate-signatures-after-subagent
hooks.description: Automatically saves sub-agent reports and secures testing/review signatures upon verified success
